metadata.title: Agentic Dataset Reference Implementation and Conformance Suite
metadata.description:
One behavioural contract for governed agentic datasets, expressed as fifteen conformance assertions (AD-001..AD-015), with a dependency-free reference control plane mapped onto four agent runtimes (a framework-free reference, LangGraph, LlamaIndex Workflows and Google ADK) and exercised across two dataset boundaries (local and MCP). Includes Authorized Recall@K, a retrieval metric defined over the subset of a corpus a principal is authorized to use.

This release carries four rights regimes and no single licence describes it. The authoritative file-to-licence map is LICENSE.md in the archived tree. In summary: specification and normative prose CC-BY-4.0; normative worlds and vectors CC0-1.0; conformance software and the Authorized Recall@K package Apache-2.0; the reference implementation BUSL-1.1, converting to Apache-2.0 on 2029-09-02. The mark in brand/ is excluded from all of them, all rights reserved.
